name: chat-app
title: Chat app
description: A two-pane chat for a pen-pal look: a pad of conversations with search and an unread filter, and a thread with a transcript that pins your message and follows the reply as it is written word by word, attachments, tool notes, a code slip with a diff, and the composer on its napkin. One pane at a time on a phone. Both panes are sheets of paper, so it looks right on paper or on the desk.

export type ChatPart =
  | { kind: "text"; text: string }
  | { kind: "tool"; title: string; result: string }
  | { kind: "code"; filename: string; code: string }

export type ChatFile = { name: string; size: string }

export type ChatTurn = {
  id: string
  from: "me" | "them"
  who?: string
  time: string
  parts: ChatPart[]
  files?: ChatFile[]
}

export type Conversation = {
  id: string
  name: string
  kind: "assistant" | "person" | "group"
  subtitle: string
  time: string
  unread: number
  turns: ChatTurn[]
  reply: ChatPart[]
  replyFrom?: string
  attachable: ChatFile[]
}

export function snippet(c: Conversation): string {
  const last = c.turns[c.turns.length - 1]
  if (!last) return "Nothing written yet"
  const text = [...last.parts].reverse().find((p) => p.kind === "text")
  const line = text && text.kind === "text" ? text.text : last.files?.[0]?.name ?? "An attachment"
  const who = last.from === "me" ? "You: " : last.who ? `${last.who}: ` : ""
  return who + line
}
